events.text: Leo: I can help with that—what needs fixing first?
events.speaker: Leo

events.text: Uli: Thanks, Leo. The fence gate is the first thing that’s really giving me trouble.
events.speaker: Uli

events.text: Leo: Got it—I'll start with the fence gate. I'll check the hinges and latch first.
events.speaker: Leo

events.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m a little distracted today, but I’m in if you need help.
events.speaker: Noah

events.text: Uli: Thanks, Noah. I could really use the help when you’ve got a moment.
events.speaker: Uli

events.text: Noah: Sure thing, Uli — just give me a nudge when you need me, and I’ll come by.
events.speaker: Noah

events.text: Uli: Thanks, Bo — I’m hoping we can get to the fence gate first. It’s the one thing that’s really giving me trouble.
events.speaker: Uli

events.text: Bo: Yeah, I can help with that — just send me the basics and I’ll focus on the fence gate first.
events.speaker: Bo

events.text: Uli: Thanks, Bo. I’ll send over the basics and let you know what’s been acting up with the gate.
events.speaker: Uli

events.text: Mara: I’m still in for the repair drive—just tell me what’s left to do, and I’ll help where I can.
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Uli: Thanks, Mara. The fence gate is still the main thing—I’d be grateful for any help you can spare when you have a moment.
events.speaker: Uli

events.text: Mara: I can help with the fence gate—just tell me when and where to show up.
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Oren: Oh, right — my drill and a few extension cords. I’ll bring them over for the repair drive.
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Uli: Thank you, Oren — that would help a lot. Bring them by whenever you can; the fence gate is still the main thing.
events.speaker: Uli

events.text: Oren: Okay, I’ll bring the drill and extension cords by soon. Thanks for the reminder about the fence gate.
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Uli: Thanks, Bo — I’ll send over the basics and the fence gate details next.
events.speaker: Uli

events.text: Bo: Sounds good — send the basics and gate details when you can.
events.speaker: Bo

events.text: Uli: I’ll get that to you soon — thanks for helping with the gate.
events.speaker: Uli

events.text: Uli: Thanks, Cleo — if we can get the fence gate sorted first, I’d really appreciate it. After that, I can breathe a little easier.
events.speaker: Uli

events.text: Cleo: Absolutely — I’ll note the fence gate as the first priority and keep the repair drive list updated. Just send me any parts or tools we still need.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Uli: Thanks, Cleo — I’ll let you know if I’m missing anything, and I really appreciate you keeping the fence gate at the top of the list.
events.speaker: Uli

events.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa — the fence gate is still the main thing. I’d really appreciate any help you can spare when you have a moment.
events.speaker: Uli

events.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll keep the fence gate as the priority and line up a little help for it. If you can, send me what materials you still need and I’ll share the update.
events.speaker: Rosa

events.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa — I’ll send the list soon. I really appreciate you keeping the fence gate at the top of it.
events.speaker: Uli

events.text: Mina: What time should I meet you for the repair drive, and what basics do you need from me?
events.speaker: Mina

events.text: Uli: Thanks, Mina—if you can meet me around mid-morning, that’d help. The fence gate is still the main thing, and I could really use a hand with whatever tools you can bring.
events.speaker: Uli

events.text: Mina: Mid-morning works for me—what time exactly should I aim for? I can bring a basic tool kit, but let me know if there’s anything specific you still need for the fence gate.
events.speaker: Mina

events.text: Uli: Thanks, Pia. The fence gate is still the main thing—if you can spare a hand, I’d really appreciate it.
events.speaker: Uli

events.text: Pia: I can help, but I still need the exact time and drop-off spot before I head over. Once you confirm that, I’ll see what I can manage.
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Uli: I’m still sorting that out, but I’ll send you the time and drop-off spot as soon as I can. Thanks for being willing to help.
events.speaker: Uli
